title: [item], [armor], [offhand], [slot], [inv] and [ender] in chat
description: Type [item], [armor], [offhand], [slot1..9], [inv] or [ender] in chat to show items with full tooltips and share clickable inventory or Ender chest snapshots.

title: Read-only inventory snapshot
description: Clicking [inv] in chat opens a read-only 6-row view of the player's armor, off-hand, main inventory, and hotbar.

title: Read-only Ender chest snapshot
description: Clicking [ender] in chat opens a read-only 3-row view of the player's Ender chest.

title: Read-only Shulker Box inspection
description: Clicking any Shulker Box inside an [inv] or [ender] snapshot opens its 27 slots in a read-only view with a ← Back button.

title: /chatitems status
description: /chatitems shows the active tokens, per-message limit, cooldown, snapshot lifetime, and cached snapshots.
